QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Radio streaming its channels over USB with an EdgeTX script
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: A radio running the Aircast USB radio script (aircast-usb.lua) streams its channels over USB serial. While it streams, its channels 1 to 18 fly the active vehicle as RC overrides. Off sends nothing.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Radio on USB (EdgeTX script)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: usbRadioStandby
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: 4G standby: the radio flies over its own link, and 4G takes over with its channels if that link drops
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The radio's channels go to the aircraft's computer instead of the flight controller. While the radio's own link flies the aircraft they are held back; if that link fades or the flight controller reports a radio failsafe, the aircraft's computer flies these channels until the link is good again. ArduPilot multicopters with aircastd only.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: 4G standby
